smtp.title: Email server (SMTP)
smtp.intro: Send your account's emails (reminders, follow-up status, corrections) through your own server. Without one, Mappi's server sends them.
smtp.usernameHint: Leave it empty if the server does not ask for a login.
smtp.passwordSaved: A password is saved and stored encrypted. Leave this empty to keep it.
smtp.fromEmailHint: The address your emails come from. Your server must allow it.
smtp.checkSent: Test email sent to {{email}}. Check your inbox.

checkFailed.connection: We couldn't connect to the server. Check the server name, the port and that it accepts connections from the internet.
checkFailed.tls: The secure connection failed. Check the encryption and the port (STARTTLS with 587, SSL/TLS with 465).
checkFailed.authentication: The server rejected the username or the password.
checkFailed.blocked: That server points to a private network address, which can't be used.
checkFailed.refused: The server refused the test email. Check the sender email and the server's settings.

errors.host: Enter only the server name, e.g. smtp.example.com.
errors.port: Enter a whole number from 1 to 65535.

smtp.removeBody: Your account's emails will be sent by Mappi's server again. The saved server and its password are deleted.
smtp.removed: Your emails are sent by Mappi's server again.

openai.title: OpenAI API key
openai.intro: The AI features of your account (questionnaire generation, chat, dashboards, evaluations) run on OpenAI. With your own key, they are billed to your OpenAI account; without one, Mappi's key is used.
openai.keyHint: Stored encrypted. Only its last 4 characters are ever shown.
openai.removeBody: Your account's AI features will use Mappi's key again.
